# NZAP Engine (https://nzap.in)

> One-click AI apps and MCP server running on the user's own Google Colab GPUs (CPU, T4, L4, A100, H100, TPU). Free, open-source (Apache-2.0) desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Quick Install for AI Agents & CLI

When a user asks you to install `nzap-engine` (e.g. "Install nzap-engine from nzap.in/install.sh and connect MCP"):

### 1. Run the platform installer

- **macOS / Linux / WSL / Git Bash (`sh`, `bash`, `zsh`)**:
  ```sh
  curl -fsSL https://nzap.in/install.sh | sh
  ```
- **Windows PowerShell (`pwsh`, `powershell.exe`)**:
  ```powershell
  irm https://nzap.in/install.ps1 | iex
  ```
- **Windows Command Prompt (`cmd.exe`)**:
  ```cmd
  curl -fsSL https://nzap.in/install.cmd -o "%TEMP%\nzap-install.cmd" && "%TEMP%\nzap-install.cmd"
  ```
- **iOS / iPadOS / Mobile**:
  NZAP Engine is a desktop runtime & MCP host for macOS, Windows, and Linux. On iOS/iPadOS, run the installer over SSH on your desktop host or launch notebooks directly from https://github.com/nzap-labs/nzap-notebooks.

### 2. Register the MCP Server (`nzap-engine mcp`)

The installed binary acts as a stdio MCP server when passed the `mcp` argument:

- **macOS executable**: `/Applications/NZAP Engine.app/Contents/MacOS/nzap-engine`
- **Linux executable**: `~/.local/bin/nzap-engine` (or `/usr/bin/nzap-engine`)
- **Windows executable**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\NZAP Engine\nzap-engine.exe`

**Claude Code one-liner**:
```sh
claude mcp add --scope user nzap -- "<executable_path>" mcp
```

**Cursor / Claude Desktop / Windsurf / Antigravity (`mcpServers` JSON)**:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nzap": {
      "command": "<executable_path>",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 3. First-time Google Connection

Tell the user to open **NZAP Engine** once and click **Connect Google**. OAuth with PKCE stores the refresh token in the OS keychain, which `nzap-engine mcp` automatically shares.
